status: PENDING OWNER APPROVAL — no database changes were made
purpose: Approval manifest for the AUTO-APPROVABLE subset of one OpenStreetMap snapshot. It is not a complete inventory of all houses in the area.
location_id: not embedded; resolve from order_locations at approved import time
rule: AUTO-APPROVABLE from the frozen snapshot: distance < 2800 m; outside and >100 m from excluded aerodrome boundary; street and house present; normalized key unambiguous; no conflicting coordinates or suspicious flags.
selection_scope: This is a partial OSM-based address selection for one delivery point, not an official or exhaustive list of all existing homes in Shchyolkovo or the surrounding area.
candidate_id_definition: osmwh: followed by SHA-256 of the normalized natural key (location key + normalized street + normalized house + normalized building). source_ids identify the OSM elements represented by that candidate.
